title: Inventory medical oxygen need and facility-readiness data sources for LMICs
outcome: A dated source inventory separating oxygen need estimates, facility oxygen readiness, equipment functionality, pulse oximetry, supply reliability, and rejected equipment-only sources.
inputs: Lancet Global Health oxygen security commission
WHO SARA and DHS SPA facility readiness sources
expected_artifact: datasets.md update plus evidence.json records for each accepted source.
validation_method: Reviewer checks each source for URL, source date, access date, measure family, oxygen source type, functionality fields, geographic grain, and limitations.
done_condition: At least six candidate sources are classified as usable, limited, or rejected with explicit reasons covering need, equipment presence, functionality, pulse oximetry, supply reliability, and access conditions.

title: Define oxygen access measure families and invalid comparisons
outcome: A measure-family specification that prevents direct comparison of oxygen need, oxygen equipment presence, oxygen functionality, and clinical-use indicators.
expected_artifact: validation.md update with measure-family definitions, denominator rules, and rejection rules.
validation_method: Replicator checks whether three sample source indicators are correctly classified and whether invalid comparisons are blocked.
done_condition: A reviewer can classify any oxygen indicator in the inventory into one measure family and name why at least three cross-family comparisons are invalid.

title: Draft a country triage memo for oxygen-system evidence readiness
outcome: A ranked shortlist of LMIC contexts where public evidence may support procurement, maintenance, or financing follow-on analysis.
expected_artifact: outputs.md update with triage memo and reproducible exclusion logic.
validation_method: Independent replicator reruns the shortlist logic, checks every exclusion reason, and confirms that no country is ranked on equipment presence alone.
done_condition: At least two contexts are classified into procurement, maintenance, or insufficient-evidence buckets with a named decision-maker and falsification condition.

title: Red-team oxygen procurement and equipment-count overreach
outcome: A failure-mode review that blocks unsafe interpretations of oxygen readiness evidence.
expected_artifact: outputs.md and playbooks.md update with blocked uses, non-use cases, and mitigation notes.
validation_method: Red-team reviewer confirms every allocation-sensitive claim has an alternative explanation, kill condition, and non-use case before it can advance.
done_condition: Every operational or allocation-sensitive claim is either blocked, narrowed, or gated behind domain review and replication.

title: Check oxygen evidence against hospital and procurement workflows
outcome: A field-facing review of whether proposed artifacts match real oxygen planning, biomedical engineering, and procurement decisions.
expected_artifact: playbooks.md update with use cases, non-use cases, timing, and workflow fit.
validation_method: Field reviewer identifies the actual user, decision, timing, required context, and misuse risk, then a second reviewer replicates the non-use-case check.
done_condition: The artifact has a named user, named decision, timing window, required local checks, non-use cases, and replicated field-reality review before publication.
